user.title: Connect to indiserver
user.description: Enter the connection details of your running indiserver instance. This integration connects as an additional client, the same way CCDciel or KStars/EKOS would, so it can run alongside them without interfering.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to indiserver. Check the host, port, and that indiserver is running and reachable.

refresh.name: Refresh properties
refresh.description: Re-request property definitions from the INDI server, optionally limited to one device.

device.name: Device
device.description: Optional INDI device name to limit the refresh to.

set_property.name: Set property
set_property.description: Send a raw newTextVector/newNumberVector/newSwitchVector to an INDI device. Use this for properties that are not exposed as entities yet.

type.name: Type
type.description: Vector type: Text, Number or Switch.

values.name: Values
values.description: Mapping of element name to value, for example: PARK set to On.
